claim_text_a: The HST/WFC3 transmission spectrum of WASP-12 b contains a high-confidence water absorption signal.
claim_text_b: One-dimensional retrievals of heterogeneous terminators can bias retrieved molecular abundances, including water, by more than an order of magnitude.

claim_text_a: High-resolution HARPS transmission spectroscopy resolves the sodium D doublet in the atmosphere of HD 189733 b at high significance.
claim_text_b: The near-infrared data indicate a small day-to-night wind in HD 189733 b and, when compared with a much larger optical sodium blueshift, imply strong vertical wind shear.

claim_text_a: The resolved sodium lines in HD 189733 b indicate hotter upper-atmosphere layers and a possible high-altitude wind blueshift.
claim_text_b: The near-infrared data indicate a small day-to-night wind in HD 189733 b and, when compared with a much larger optical sodium blueshift, imply strong vertical wind shear.
